reply.text:
Soreness that hangs around after every leg day is something I can't read for you. That one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach, and I won't tell you it's expected or fine. If it's sharp, worsening, or affecting how you move, get it looked at before your next session.

On the training side, I can look at your program and what's coming up next. Give me a moment and I'll pull that up. The program lookup came back empty, so I can't see what's scheduled next yet. Once you've got a program running in the app, I can tell you exactly what's up. If you'd like me to put one together, tell me your goal, how many days you can train, and what equipment you have, and I'll build it for you.
